rationale: The Latin anchors *repellere* (to drive back/repel) and *extorquere* (to wrest/extort by force) point to a sense of forcible compulsion or restraint rather than mere tightening of rules. *restrain.v.04* (hold back) better captures the active, physical force implied by these Latin verbs than *stiffen.v.03*, which suggests an abstract restriction.
